- N2 [Low] (same, О33): the result chips carry the question only in title; give each chip aria-label "<question>: <answer>" and a row that reads the accessible names with all answers «Не знаю».
- N3 [Low] (same, О33): no_match_text of the intake (ru, kk, en) names an answer the visitor did not give; make it conditional; the picker check must exit 0.
- SECURITY L1 [Low] (step-03c-security-reviewer.json, О28): a question, option or solution id that is an object or an array must give 503 demo_unavailable on the demo routes; DM-6c rows for an object id and an array id in a question and in an option through the function entry; the mutant «id copied whole» red.
- REVIEWER L3 [Low] (step-04c-reviewer.json, О27): answer() in demo.js serializes the body and discards it, the app serializes again, the comment says «once»; carry the text or reword the comment truthfully; behaviour and the 503 mapping unchanged.
Not touched: the lows L1 and L2 of the reviewer's pass 3 (О26, the owner's G21 list) and the other findings.
